entities.summary: Nelson Efamehule Agholor is a Nigerian-American professional football wide receiver. He played college football for the USC Trojans and was selected by the Philadelphia Eagles in the first round of the 2015 NFL draft. During his five seasons with the Eagles, Agholor won Super Bowl LII. He also played one season with the Las Vegas Raiders, two with the New England Patriots, and two more for the Baltimore Ravens.
